# Write your MySQL query statement below
WITH
    t AS (
        SELECT
            order_id,
            MAX(quantity) AS max_quantity,
            SUM(quantity) / COUNT(1) AS avg_quantity
        FROM OrdersDetails
        GROUP BY order_id
    )
SELECT order_id
FROM t
WHERE max_quantity > (SELECT MAX(avg_quantity) FROM t);
title: Orders With Maximum Quantity Above Average
